SharpBlocks - generic C# trailing-block DSL transpiler

Usage:
  sharpblocks check <file.csdsl>
  sharpblocks validate-debug-map <file.csdsl>
  sharpblocks format <file.csdsl> [--write|-o <file>]
  sharpblocks compile <file.csdsl> -o <file.g.cs> [--namespace My.App] [--class Name] [--method Build]
  sharpblocks registry <files.csdsl...> -o <Registry.g.cs> [--namespace My.App] [--class SharpBlocksRegistry] [--method BuildAll]

Syntax:
  Foo { Bar(123) }        => Foo(() => { Bar(123); });
  Foo("x") { Bar() }    => Foo("x", () => { Bar(); });
  let x = 123             => var x = 123;
  cs { /* raw C# */ }     => copied into generated method
